verdict.rationale: Poly documents its own programmatic surfaces. The main one is a hosted MCP endpoint (https://mcp.poly.app/mcp, streamable HTTP, OAuth), which a runtime probe confirmed is live and speaks the MCP OAuth flow; the other is a scriptable `poly` CLI that agents can compose for search, read, create, update and organize. There is no general-purpose public REST API: every OpenAPI/Swagger path probed returned 404, so programmatic access appears limited to MCP and CLI channels. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose public HTTP/REST API with an OpenAPI spec or API reference, documented API keys/tokens for non-MCP clients, and independent corroboration of driving the product programmatically.
